parameters.name: CustomPageHtml
parameters.description: The custom waiting room page content. This parameter is required when the waiting room type is set to custom. The content must use Base64 encoding.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the waiting room.

parameters.name: DisableSessionRenewalEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to disable session renewal. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
The waiting room switch. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The event end timestamp, such as 1705044735.

parameters.name: JsonResponseEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable JSON response. When enabled, requests with an Accept header containing "application/json" return JSON data. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description:
The language of the waiting room page. This parameter is required when the waiting room type is set to default. Valid values:

- **enus**: English.
- **zhcn**: Simplified Chinese.
- **zhhk**: Traditional Chinese.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the waiting room event.

parameters.name: NewUsersPerMinute
parameters.description: The number of new users per minute.

parameters.name: PreQueueEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable pre-queuing. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.

parameters.name: PreQueueStartTime
parameters.description: The pre-queuing start timestamp, which must be at least 5 minutes earlier than the event start timestamp, such as 1705044735.

parameters.name: QueuingMethod
parameters.description:
The queuing method. Valid values:

- **random**: random.
- **fifo**: first-in, first-out.
- **passthrough**: passthrough.
- **reject-all**: reject all.

parameters.name: QueuingStatusCode
parameters.description:
The waiting room status code. Valid values:

- **200**
- **202**
- **429**.

parameters.name: RandomPreQueueEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable random pre-queuing. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.

parameters.name: SessionDuration
parameters.description: The session duration, in minutes.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The event start timestamp, such as 1705044735.

parameters.name: TotalActiveUsers
parameters.description: The total number of active users.

parameters.name: WaitingRoomId
parameters.description: The waiting room ID. You can call the [ListWaitingRooms](~~2850279~~) operation to obtain the waiting room ID. The waiting room must belong to the site specified by SiteId.

parameters.name: WaitingRoomType
parameters.description:
The type of the waiting room. Valid values:

- **default**: default type.
- **custom**: custom type.
